dm.compromised:
Your message in **{guild}** was removed because it contained content commonly associated with scams or compromised accounts.

**If you didn't send this message, your Discord account is likely compromised.** Please take the following steps immediately:

**1. Change your Discord password** | [Account Settings](https://discord.com/channels/@me) → My Account → Change Password. Use a unique password you don't reuse anywhere else.
**2. Enable Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)** | [discord.com/safety/keeping-your-account-safe](https://discord.com/safety/keeping-your-account-safe)
**3. Log out of all sessions** | Settings → Devices → Log Out All Known Devices.
**4. Revoke suspicious authorized apps** | Settings → Authorized Apps, remove anything you don't recognize.
**5. Scan your computer for malware** | Token-stealers are common; run a reputable antivirus.
**6. Check your email** | Make sure no rules are forwarding Discord emails elsewhere, and reset that password too if it's reused.

**Helpful Resources:**
• [Discord: My Account Was Hacked](https://support.discord.com/hc/en-us/articles/218410947-My-Account-was-Hacked)
• [Discord: Keeping Your Account Safe](https://support.discord.com/hc/en-us/articles/4410384472359)
• [Discord Trust & Safety](https://discord.com/safety)

If you sent the message intentionally, please contact a staff member.
honeypot.warning:
## ⚠️ Do not post in this channel
This is a moderation **honeypot**. There is no reason for a real member to send a message here.

**Anyone who posts in this channel is automatically {action}**, as it's a trap for spam bots and compromised accounts. Please ignore this channel entirely.

setup.title: # Thanks for adding Frostbite!
setup.body:
I protect this server from scams — phishing links, scam images, and compromised-account spam. Setup takes three commands (needs **Manage Server**):

**1.** `/filter stringfilter enabled:true` and `/filter imagefilter enabled:true` — turn the scam filters on
**2.** `/filter setlogchannel` — pick where removals are reported
**3.** `/filter status` — confirm everything is ready

Filters cover **every channel** by default.
-# More options: `/filter categories` (exclude categories), `/filter setstaffrole` (bypass role), `/filter honeypot` (trap channel), `/language server` (my language here).
setup.perms: -# Grant my role **View Channel**, **Read Message History**, and **Manage Messages** server-wide (plus **Ban Members** if you use the honeypot) — I can't filter channels I can't see.
